text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Normally, the standard strategy for 
Umamusume aiming for the Triple Crown is 
to target medium and long distances."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yet here I am. At the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen, where the sprint champion is 
crowned.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To walk the path of a first-class lady in 
my own way.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if this path turns out to be wrong... 
I won't regret it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Even if that were true—
choice_data_list:
When that time comes, we'll just start 
over from scratch.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu. So you're fully prepared too, huh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Well then, let us begin. Our—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...That's Mother, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, what perfect timing. You, hold onto 
this phone for me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't 'huh' me. Come on, lend me a hand.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Mm. That angle works. Alright, here I go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Good day, Mother.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ""...What do you think you're doing?""

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"We received word on our end as well. That 
your young lady is running in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. I came here to win the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"What, are you out of your mind? 1200m on 
turf is a completely different playing 
field, you know?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"It's different from the medium and long 
distances you've run until now. The 
strategy for a marathon is totally 
different from a sprint, you know?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"That's reckless. Trying to win right off 
the bat in a GⅠ race packed with 
professionals? Not to mention with all 
those bashing articles—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm a professional too, you know.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I chose this race as a top-class Umamusume 
who has run in countless races.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone says, I have both 
the confidence and the chance to win.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you a race that belongs to 
nobody else but "King Halo" herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, the declaration is made. Let's 
go."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: To our Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
